profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | MSCS Student @ CityU
profile.summary:
I am a passionate web developer who specializes in bringing ideas to life through elegant and functional websites. As a full-stack developer, I thrive on tackling challenges and creating solutions that not only meet but exceed user expectations. My expertise extends to Python, Javascript, Typescript, React, Angular, HTML/CSS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, FastAPI, Node.js, and Express allowing me to build robust and scalable applications.

Let's connect and explore how my skills and passion for web development can contribute to creating exceptional online experiences. I am actively seeking new opportunities and open to collaboration, projects, and roles that allow me to grow in this ever-evolving digital landscape.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Works with clients to build web applications for their businesses.

Skills: Project Management • Organizational • Resourcefulness • Client-Focused • Creativity • Problem-Solving • Continuous Learning • Collaboration • Decision Making

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
As a key contributor in a small team, I played a crucial role in designing and implementing features for Anaconda cloud and payment platforms. My efforts included streamlining the user interface and creating a user-friendly CMS interface. I contributed significantly to the seamless communication between front-end and back-end systems by creating and maintaining RESTful APIs, allowing integration with third-party services. My commitment to project success was evident in active participation in Agile methodologies, leading meetings, and conducting feature demos. I ensured the reliability of backend components through rigorous testing, and collaborated closely with back-end developers to create robust data models.

Skills: Angular • Typescript • Python • Docker • Kubernetes • PostgreSQL • SQLAlchemy • RESTful APIs • Jest • HTML/CSS • SASS • Material UI • Kendo • Bootstrap • Stripe • Mailchimp • Postman • Git • Agile Methodology • Jira • Miro • Figma
